content.title: SEC Punts Controversial Short-Sale Disclosure Deadline Again
content.summary: Investment managers will now have until Jan. 2, 2028 to comply with the short-sale rules and until Sept. 28, 2028 on the related stock lending disclosures, the SEC said in an order Wednesday.  While short selling has long been a practice in US markets, it has faced heightened scrutiny following the 2008 financial crisis and after investors piled into so-called memestocks like GameStop Corp. in 2021.  The SEC issued the rules in October 2023, requiring certain investment managers to report short-sale data on a monthly basis.
